s1.text:
Back to: Nail POS Hub
https://claude.ai/artifact/9HZ5deX1wVYaLzG895UciU

Setup day = about 1 hour, Elang beside the owner.
• Demo → hardware + texting registration → setup day → first payment in ~1 week
• Every step saves; owner can stop and come back
• Skip anything except Payments and $1 test
• English first; language switch in each person's profile
• Grey sticky under each screen = what every tap does

Open
• Stripe Connect Express vs Standard (lean Express)
• Reader: S710 now vs M2 later
• Invite link expiry (proposal 7 days), 24 h reminder
• PIN = 4 digits or staff phone number? Confirm with Elang

p1.text:
OPEN — confirm with Elang
Staff login: 4-digit PIN (drawn now) OR the staff's phone number?

Affects: Staff step 4 (invite text), staff phone S1 (make PIN), clock-in, Switch person, Print my earnings, Reset PIN, checkout Profile.

Think about: speed at a busy front desk (4 taps vs 10), privacy (phone numbers seen by others), shared iPad, staff who change phones.

n1.text:
TAPS · Sign up
• Text me a code → screen fades to 6 code boxes; cursor on next empty box
• Wrong code → boxes shake, red “That code didn't work”, clear
• Resend in 0:30 countdown → then “Resend” / “Call me instead”
• Change number → back to phone screen, number kept
• Verify → Step 2 (side list ticks ✓ 1, bar grows)

n2.text:
TAPS · Salon info
• Typing → “Saved” pill flashes after 1 s idle (no Save button)
• Day chip → toggles open/closed; long-press → set hours for that day
• State chip → lock card text swaps (fade). CA/MN = locked tip rules
• Address → suggestions list as you type (pick one fills city/ZIP)
• Continue → Step 3; Back → Step 1 (nothing lost)

n3.text:
TAPS · Services (try it in Play)
• Snap your menu → camera / upload photo or PDF → “Reading your menu…” (green scan line + 4 checks tick)
• Result list: each row shows what AI read (“read as Gel Mani”); unsure ones orange ▲ (e.g. “50+”, guessed time)
• Retake photo → back to choose; blurry photo → “Couldn't read it — try closer, less glare”
• Start from a nail template → template list instead
• Switch → service off: row dims, count updates; price field → number pad
• Looks right · Continue → saved; Continue grey until a list exists

n4.text:
TAPS · Staff (try it in Play)
• + Add staff → form fades in on the right
• Phone <10 digits / already on team → red line, Add grey
• Pay type → stepper unit changes (%, $/hr, $/wk)
• Add + text invite → row appears (green flash) → “Sending…” → “Text sent” + Undo toast 6 s
• Undo → row removed, text cancelled
• Tap row → detail + 4-step timeline; Resend / Set up on this iPad / Reset PIN / Remove
• Demo button simulates staff finishing → “PIN set ✓”
• Full map: board “Staff setup — flow map”
• OPEN: 4-digit PIN or phone number — confirm with Elang

n5.text:
TAPS · Payments (try it in Play)
• Connect with Stripe → Stripe opens in a new window; this card shows “Finish in the Stripe window” (pulse)
• Done in Stripe → auto-updates to “Payments connected” ✓ pop + bank
• Cancel → back to start
• Stripe needs more info → “Almost done” card: Fix in Stripe / Do it later
• Continue is grey until connected (or “Do it later”)

n6.text:
TAPS · Devices
• Pair reader → type the 3 words shown on reader → card gets green ring, ✓ pops
• Reader not found (30 s) → “Is it on Wi-Fi?” help + Try again
• Print test receipt → printer prints; “Did it print?” Yes / No → No opens printer help
• Link device → QR on screen; scanning it on the iPad links it
• Skip for now → QR / pay link stays available

n7.text:
TAPS · Clients
• Option card → 2px border; panel below swaps (fade)
• Upload a file → file picker → read result: found / with phone / duplicates merged
• Bad file → “We couldn't read this file” + Try another
• We help type them in → upload photos of the client book
• Start fresh → nothing to do; clients added at checkout

n8.text:
TAPS · $1 test (try it in Play)
• Charge $1.00 → 4 checks tick one by one (0.9 s each)
• Card declined / reader offline → that row turns orange with Try again
• All done → “Mai Nails is ready” ✓ pop, summary
• Run test again → back to start
• Open front desk → Today screen; setup checklist stays in Settings for skipped steps

n9.text:
TAPS · Staff phone (try it in Play)
• Tap link in text → “Is this you?” (name, salon, role, pay)
• Not me → link turned off, owner told
• Yes → pick English / Tiếng Việt (switches every screen after)
• PIN: dots fill per tap; ⌫ deletes; 1111/1234 → shake “Too easy”
• Type again: mismatch → shake, start over; match → PIN saved ✓
• Continue → Clock in: big button → “Clocked in ✓”, turn # and first appointment fade in; tap again = clock out
• OPEN: 4-digit PIN or phone number — confirm with Elang
